symbols.mapping: PaintCache Vecs and source Arc are released by Rust ownership when the job cache leaves scope; no raw callback or double-free API is retained.
`paint::edge_span` uses checked addition and slice lookup; empty, overflowing, and out-of-range spans return None and clear formed.
`cache::hash` ports the frozen 64-bit mixing sequence and masks to 65,536 slots; the key is definition plus viewport bits.
cache::replacement fallibly creates accepted shared slot/entry vectors with actual-capacity overlap leases; no local replacement cache type.
`cache::find_template` probes the accepted PaintCache, checks indices before access, compares definition/viewport/source Arc, and validates the selected template/range/stops.
cache::replacement/reconcile grows 16/doubling/32768 entries, admits full old/new overlap and retains actual growth in the same source job.
cache::insert_template transfers the one admitted cold Vec into GradientCacheEntry without stop copying; errors release its stop lease and provisional buffers.
`resolver::eq` compares validated XmlSpan bytes without rewriting source.
`gradient_data::attr` scans only the selected element’s attribute run and accepts unprefixed exact names.
`cache::token_visit` uses checked cumulative accounting, caps at 4,194,304, and charges the caller WorkControl and ChargeLedger.
`resolver::attributes_supported` ports gradient kind, namespace, href/common/coordinate allowlists and token charging.
`resolver::gradient_href` validates one local #id href and only accepts xlink when its namespace is bound.
`gradient_data::inherited_gradient_color` rebuilds a fixed 64-element ancestor stack and computes CSS per gradient in the href chain.
`gradient_data::element_end` handles empty elements and scans a matching-depth close tag with per-token charging.
`gradient_data::number` preserves the 96-byte bound, leading C whitespace, finite 1e6 magnitude cap, and percent conversion.
`gradient_data::parse_css_color` adapts the accepted source-span color parser; values remain tied to DecodeSource.
`gradient_data::resolve_stop_color` handles explicit colors, inherited/currentColor, and the original opaque black fallback.
`gradient_data::supported_stop_inline_style` accepts only stop-color, stop-opacity, and color declarations.
`gradient_data::collect_stops` applies computed CSS, default offset/color/opacity, order/range checks, lround alpha scaling, 256-stop cap, and href fallback.
`gradient_data::read_coordinates` preserves objectBox/userSpace defaults, units, percentages, focal defaults, and positive radial radius.
`resolver::collect_chain` enforces same-kind chains, local hrefs, cycle rejection, per-link attributes, and maximum 16 links.

resolve_cached_fill/resolve_cached_context implement the complete resolver, return actual borrowed cached stops and explicit source/definition/viewport identity, rebind each instance, and publish through CachedPaint::append_fill/stroke. resolve_fill is separately accounted owned compatibility; see owned-interface-gap.md.
`paint::sample` validates ranges/stops/geometry before access and preserves transform order, linear/radial math, spread, endpoint selection, and rounded channel interpolation.

algorithms.name: safe edge-span formed flag and checked pointer range
algorithms.mapping: Covered by edge_span_preserves_empty_and_invalid_range_contract.

algorithms.name: cache key combines definition, viewport width/height, source-owner witness, and template context
algorithms.mapping: Cache entries normalize instance inverse/bounds and include viewport, definition, and Arc source witness; tests prove same-template rebind and viewport separation.

algorithms.name: cache hash, fixed slot count, open addressing, bounded probes
algorithms.mapping: 65,536-slot open addressing and charged probes; insertion bounds are inherited from 32,768 entry capacity.

algorithms.name: cache entry and stop ownership/destruction
algorithms.mapping: Shared GradientCacheEntry owns source/context/stops; Vec/Arc drops on cache/job teardown.

algorithms.name: cache entry/slot capacities and shared controlled storage validation
algorithms.mapping: Actual cold stop/slot/entry capacities and growth overlap are admitted. Cold allocation count/live/history and peak overlap have direct tests; hits leave stats and capacities unchanged.

algorithms.name: source-span equality and safe attribute lookup
algorithms.mapping: Exact XmlSpan byte equality and bounded attribute-run scan; no source data borrows escape.

algorithms.name: paint token-visit limit 4194304 and controlled probe charging
algorithms.mapping: Cumulative checked counter and controlled token/reference work; 4,096-comment/512-fill original-scale case is ported.

algorithms.name: linear/radial attribute allowlist and fallback classification
algorithms.mapping: Linear/radial allowlists are enforced; patterns classify as PaintReference::Pattern and are not converted to solids.

algorithms.name: href and bound xlink href syntax/reference resolution
algorithms.mapping: Local href and namespace-bound xlink tested; unbound xlink is rejected.

algorithms.name: same-kind gradient inheritance chain, cycle detection, maximum 16 links
algorithms.mapping: Kind checked at each link, repeated IDs rejected, fixed 16-link bound; cycle rejection tested.

algorithms.name: ancestor stack CSS color inheritance, maximum depth 64
algorithms.mapping: Fixed 64-slot stack and per-ancestor CSS compute; currentColor inheritance tested.

algorithms.name: element subtree end scan and work charging
algorithms.mapping: Matching-depth end scan charges each examined token; exercised on nested gradient source and comments.

algorithms.name: finite number parsing, 96-byte value bound, 1e6 magnitude and percent conversion
algorithms.mapping: Exact bounds and conversion in number helper; percent offsets are exercised in resolver tests.

algorithms.name: stop-color parsing, currentColor inherited color and black fallback
algorithms.mapping: Color helper plus currentColor and black default paths; inherited SVG color and explicit CSS color tests.

algorithms.name: stop inline style allowlist and CSS computed property validation
algorithms.mapping: Inline property allowlist and computed non-stop-property rejection are active; class selector and inline declarations tested.

algorithms.name: stop defaults, offset order/range, opacity multiplication, maximum 256 stops
algorithms.mapping: Defaults/order/opacity rounding are implemented; exact 256 and 257-stop boundaries tested.

algorithms.name: inherited linear/radial coordinates, units, percentage references, focal defaults and positive radius
algorithms.mapping: Coordinate defaults/ancestor chain, objectBox/userSpace references and radial focal defaults are implemented; linear/radial outputs tested.

algorithms.name: gradient transform parse/inverse and source operation order
algorithms.mapping: Accepted transform parser and inverse are used; inverse translation is asserted and sampler applies user then gradient inverse.

algorithms.name: template cache by definition/viewport and instance bounds/inverse rebind
algorithms.mapping: CachedPaint borrows the exact cache stop slice, public context lifetime is independent of temporary fields, and 40000 hits preserve pointer/capacity/accounting while inverse/bounds rebind.

algorithms.name: shape bounds from every local edge endpoint; empty/degenerate handling
algorithms.mapping: Both endpoints of every edge are mapped with checked affine math; empty edge and zero-area objectBox errors are explicit.

algorithms.name: global 65536 paint-stop admission, shared template range and rollback-safe graph publication
algorithms.mapping: Exact cache 65536/256 limits remain proved. Actual CachedPaint append_template publication shares graph stops; standalone harness proves 40000 fill/stroke instances with 2 stops and rollback/cancellation/source/scene validation.

algorithms.name: pattern reference classification and planner handoff
algorithms.mapping: Pattern is returned explicitly by classify_fill. Native pattern construction remains assigned to the later definitions/provider engine; resolve_fill does not return success for patterns.

algorithms.name: sample transform order, linear projection and zero-length t=1
algorithms.mapping: Midpoint, exact pixel channels, degenerate linear t=1, and nonfinite no-write behavior are tested.

algorithms.name: sample radial focal quadratic, degenerate coefficient fallback and finite roots
algorithms.mapping: Radial focal quadratic and near-zero coefficient branch are retained; radial center sampler case is tested.

algorithms.name: pad/reflect/repeat spread and negative t behavior
algorithms.mapping: Spread operation is ported; repeat/reflect values past the endpoint are exact-tested; pad is covered by linear interpolation.

algorithms.name: endpoint clamp, duplicate offsets, lround byte interpolation and invalid range no-write
algorithms.mapping: Endpoint branches and duplicate offsets follow original loop; exact channels, midpoint rounding, invalid range/order no-write are tested.

algorithms.name: original diagnostic category/source-offset preservation
algorithms.mapping: Malformed fill XmlSpan bounds return exact ErrorKind::Unsupported at the caller fill offset, matching paint.c:553. Tests assert beyond-source offset, beyond-remaining length, usize overflow, empty and short spans through classify_fill, resolve_cached_fill and resolve_fill; valid URL counterparts, unchanged complete ledger/cache accounting and resolver cancellation priority are also asserted.

shared_integration_gap: Owned-only DecodeOperations::resolve_paint cannot carry a borrowed cache slice or releasable lease. Root must adopt the real cached producer/handoff or approve a shared repair; complete accounted owned compatibility is preserved.
